defects.title: The documented option minLB is ignored and replaced by its default

defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-23) with param.minLB = -1 the parameter display of line 151 shows minLB: -10; line 73 tests isfield(param, 'maxLB') instead of 'minLB', so line 74 always overwrites minLB with min(-max(ub), min(lb))
defects.expected: a given minLB is kept and bounds the relaxed lower bounds (line 431)

defects.title: Omitting the documented option toBeUnblockedReactions stops with an error
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-23) 'Unrecognized field name "toBeUnblockedReactions".' at line 326; every other option gets a default in lines 70-141
